worldcombat.skill.dualchop.summary: Raise a hard limb and chop twice from a standstill: the first blow is a narrow, heavy vertical cleave along the aim line that only catches the first target on its path; the second is a short, wide horizontal sweep centred on where the first blow landed, cutting both sides. The crack is only the visual line where the first blow touched the ground and changes no blocks.
worldcombat.skill.dualchop.use.0: Plant, cleave the aim line vertically, then sweep both sides of the landing point
worldcombat.skill.dualchop.use.1: First blow narrow and heavy, second blow short and wide for several targets
worldcombat.skill.dualchop.use.2: Sweep a small forward patch of foes with the horizontal cut
worldcombat.skill.dualchop.description.0: The first blow cleaves the aim line: about %1$s physical damage, out to %2$s blocks, cut half-width %3$s blocks, hitting only the first target on the path.
worldcombat.skill.dualchop.description.1: The second blow sweeps a short, wide horizontal cut centred on the first blow's landing point, radius %2$s blocks and %3$s degrees, hitting up to %4$s targets for about %1$s physical damage each.
worldcombat.skill.dualchop.description.2: Gap between blows %1$s; the first blow shoves its target %2$s blocks along the aim line.
worldcombat.skill.dualchop.description.3: The first blow leaves a brief visual ground crack; it only draws a line and changes no blocks.
worldcombat.skill.dualchop.timing: Range %1$s blocks, windup %2$s, recovery %3$s, costs %4$s PP, cooldown %5$s.
worldcombat.skill.dualchop.growth.0: From level %1$s the first-blow power rises to %2$s.
worldcombat.skill.dualchop.growth.1: From level %1$s the first-blow power is %2$s and the second-blow power is %3$s.
worldcombat.skill.dualchop.growth.2: From level %1$s the first-blow power rises to %2$s.
worldcombat.skill.dualchop.preference.ai: Beyond this distance it will not chop and closes in first; this move is short-ranged, so it usually walks into reach.
When on, low-health targets rank higher so the two blows finish them; when off, all targets rank the same.
When on, the companion may leave its post to chop; when off, it only casts at what it can reach from where it stands.
